name: Antler Communion
flavour: The sprout climbs the deer's antlers and they grow together.

name: Mother of Groves
flavour: Bear and stag kneel; the grove itself stands up.

name: Kindled Pack
flavour: Pup and chick chase each other until the fire catches.

name: The Laughing Inferno
flavour: The ram charges into the drake's fire and something laughs.

name: Ashbloom
flavour: Green meets ember and something new steps out of the ash.
